name: Box Breathing
description: A calming technique that equalizes your breathing pattern to reduce anxiety and stress immediately.

steps.instruction: Breathe in through your nose
Hold your breath
Breathe out through your mouth
Hold empty

name: 4-7-8 Breathing
description: A powerful relaxation technique that helps you fall asleep and reduces worry by slowing your nervous system.

steps.instruction: Breathe in for 4 counts
Hold for 7 counts
Exhale for 8 counts

name: Deep Belly Breathing
description: A simple breathing technique that activates your body's relaxation response using your diaphragm.

steps.instruction: Breathe in slowly through your nose, filling your belly (not chest)
Hold for 2 counts
Exhale slowly through your mouth

name: Alternate Nostril Breathing
description: A yogic technique that balances your mind and body by breathing through one nostril at a time.

steps.instruction: Close right nostril, breathe in left for 4 counts
Close left nostril, exhale right for 4 counts
Breathe in right for 4 counts
Close right nostril, exhale left for 4 counts

name: Coherent Breathing
description: A gentle 5-minute breathing pattern that synchronizes breathing with heart rhythm to promote relaxation.

steps.instruction: Breathe in for 5 counts
Breathe out for 5 counts

name: 5-4-3-2-1 Sensory Grounding
description: Engage your five senses to anchor yourself in the present moment and reduce anxiety or panic.

steps.instruction: Identify 5 things you can SEE around you. Notice colors, shapes, and textures.
Notice 4 things you can TOUCH. Feel the textures.
Listen for 3 things you can HEAR. Be still and listen.
Identify 2 things you can SMELL or taste.
Acknowledge 1 thing you can TASTE or a previous sense you enjoyed.

name: Cold Water Plunge (TIPP Skill)
description: Activate your body's dive response by splashing cold water on your face to quickly shift your emotional state.

steps.instruction: Get a bowl of cold water or splash cold water on your face
Take a few slow breaths to notice the change in your body

name: Pressure Release (Progressive Muscle Tension)
description: Systematically tense and release different muscle groups to release physical tension and anxiety.

steps.instruction: Tense your feet for 5 seconds, then release. Notice the difference.
Tense your legs for 5 seconds, then release
Tense your stomach and chest for 5 seconds, then release
Tense your arms and hands for 5 seconds, then release
Tense your face and neck for 5 seconds, then release
Tense your whole body, then fully release. Feel the calm.

name: Body Scan Meditation
description: Slowly move your attention through your body, noticing sensations without judgment, to reduce stress and increase awareness.

steps.instruction: Close your eyes and take 3 deep breaths. Get comfortable.
Notice your feet. Any sensations? Just observe without changing anything.
Move attention to your legs. Feel any tension or ease?
Notice your torso and stomach. Any tightness or relaxation?
Bring awareness to your arms and hands. Observe sensations.
Focus on your head, face, and neck. Notice any tension.
Take 3 deep breaths, slowly opening your eyes when ready

name: Mindful Observation
description: Pick one object and observe it deeply for several minutes to anchor your mind in the present moment.

steps.instruction: Pick one object nearby (plant, cup, etc.)
Observe its colors. What shades do you see?
Notice its shape and texture. How does light reflect on it?
Consider its purpose. What is it made of?
Let your mind simply rest on this object for the remaining time

name: Loving-Kindness Meditation
description: Send wishes of wellness and peace to yourself and others to cultivate compassion and reduce self-criticism.

steps.instruction: Close your eyes. Place your hand on your heart.
Say to yourself: 'May I be safe. May I be healthy. May I be happy.'
Think of someone you love. Say: 'May you be safe. May you be healthy. May you be happy.'
Think of someone neutral. Send them the same wishes.
Think of someone difficult. Send them compassion anyway.
Expand to all beings. 'May all beings be safe, healthy, and happy.'

name: Mindful Eating
description: Eat one small snack slowly and mindfully, engaging all your senses to find peace in the present moment.

steps.instruction: Choose a small snack (raisin, piece of chocolate, berry)
Look at it closely. Notice its color, shape, and texture.
Smell it. What aromas do you notice?
Put it in your mouth without chewing. Notice the taste and texture.
Slowly chew, noticing flavors developing and changing

name: Jumping Jacks & Movement
description: Do 50 jumping jacks or other vigorous movement to release energy and shift your mood through exercise.

steps.instruction: Do 50 jumping jacks at your own pace
Catch your breath. Stretch your arms and legs.
Notice how you feel. You've released energy!

name: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
description: Systematically relax muscle groups after tensing them to release physical tension and promote deep relaxation.

steps.instruction: Tense your right hand and arm for 5 seconds. Release and notice the relaxation.
Tense your left hand and arm. Hold for 5 seconds. Release.
Tense your forehead. Hold. Release.
Tense your jaw. Hold. Release.
Tense your shoulders. Hold. Release.
Tense your chest. Hold. Release.
Tense your stomach. Hold. Release.
Tense your right leg. Hold. Release.
Tense your left leg. Hold. Release.
Relax your entire body. Feel the deep calm.

name: Dance or Stretch
description: Put on your favorite song and dance or do gentle stretches to release tension and improve mood.

steps.instruction: Choose your favorite upbeat song or put on music you love
Dance freely for the song, moving your body however it feels good
Gently stretch your body to cool down

name: A Brief Walk
description: Take a short walk outside to connect with nature, clear your mind, and shift your emotional state.

steps.instruction: Step outside or to a window. Get some fresh air.
Walk at a comfortable pace for 5 minutes. Notice your surroundings.
Come back inside. Notice how you feel.

name: Positive Affirmations
description: Repeat positive statements about yourself to challenge negative thoughts and build self-compassion.

steps.instruction: Find a quiet space. Take 3 deep breaths to center yourself.
Say to yourself: 'I am worthy. I am strong. I deserve kindness.'
Say: 'I am capable. I can handle difficult moments. This will pass.'
Say your own affirmations that resonate with you

name: Gratitude Reflection
description: Think about or write down things you're grateful for to shift focus from problems to positivity.

steps.instruction: Get a pen and paper or your phone
Write down 3-5 things you're grateful for, big or small
For each item, write one sentence about why it matters to you

name: Self-Compassion Break
description: Practice speaking to yourself with kindness during difficult moments using this mindful self-compassion technique.

steps.instruction: Notice you're struggling. Say: 'This is a moment of suffering.'
Remember: 'Suffering is part of life. I'm not alone in this.'
Place your hand on your heart. Say: 'May I be kind to myself. May I give myself the compassion I need.'

name: Worry Time Container
description: Set aside 10 minutes to worry deliberately, then consciously put your worries aside for the rest of the day.

steps.instruction: Write down all your worries on paper for 10 minutes
When done, fold the paper. Say: 'I've acknowledged my worries. I can handle them later.'
Set the paper aside. For the rest of your day, redirect worry thoughts: 'That's for worry time.'

name: Visualization: Safe Place
description: Imagine a peaceful, safe place in detail to calm your nervous system and find mental refuge.

steps.instruction: Close your eyes. Take 3 deep breaths.
Imagine a place where you feel completely safe and peaceful.
See the colors, shapes, and details of this place
Notice sounds, smells, and textures in this safe place
Stay here as long as you'd like. When ready, slowly return.
